name: Johnny Garcia
office: City of Pico Rivera, Member of the City Council

items.text: John R. Garcia was elected to the Pico Rivera City Council in November 2022. He worked for over 25 years at the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles and the City of San Buenaventura, and served on the Pico Rivera Parks and Recreation and Planning Commissions. He supports a comprehensive approach to public safety that combines enforcement with prevention, careful budgeting and transparency, maintaining parks and recreation, investment in streets and infrastructure, and economic development. In July 2026, he took part in the groundbreaking for the $39.4 million Smith Park Community & Aquatic Center project.
